name: setreuid
description: setreuid() sets the real and effective user IDs of the calling process. Supplying a value of -1 for either ID leaves it unchanged. Unprivileged processes have restrictions on which IDs they can set.

parameters.name: ruid
parameters.description: Real user ID to set, or -1 to leave unchanged

parameters.name: euid
parameters.description: Effective user ID to set, or -1 to leave unchanged

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: The call would change the caller’s real UID, but there was a temporary failure or resource limit issue.
One or more of the target user IDs is not valid in this user namespace.
The process is not privileged and the specified change is not allowed.
